verdict.rationale: Fin's own docs show it transfers escalated conversations to human agents in the team's preferred inbox, has configurable escalation rules, and offers an 'Escalate to a human' endpoint in the Preview API. Nothing in the pack shows that the handoff includes an AI-generated summary or the details Fin collected, or that the customer avoids repeating themselves. Missing for 10: documented handoff summary, documented transfer of collected customer details, explicit confirmation that the full transcript carries over, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, when the agent escalates, the human gets the full conversation, a summary, and collected details — the customer never repeats themselves

citations.quote: Transfers to agents directly in preferred Inbox
Manage Fin AI Agent's escalation guidance and rules
The new orchestration endpoints — Discover capabilities, Ask Fin, Run a procedure, and Escalate to a human — are currently available in the Preview API version only.
